The ceiling is deliberately NOT applied, because an upper bound above it may be inside it once the book discounts.

calibration_warning: ⚠️ These confidence numbers are running high. board_rule: Sorted by the player's own record at that exact line, highest first — the same order the MLB board uses. Rows with no record sit below every row that has one.

college_note: College records are counted over the games a player appears in.
